Method of Attack: Injected malicious module that stole cryptocurrency by redirecting transactions to attacker-controlled wallet addresses
Crypto-jacking by hooking Ethereum and Solana signing requests and swapping wallet addresses
Attack Vector: Phishing attack via password reset lure on maintainer Josh Junon's (qix) account
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious package versions available on npm for 2 hours
Malicious code reached 1 in 10 cloud environments
Attacker-controlled wallet addresses flagged and tracked
